answer: Alias swarms collapse when a landing berth cannot be photocopied. Each applicant rents one numbered slip at a public river wharf and binds it to a single live key. They drive a serialized willow staff into the flood mark and keep a twelve-minute dusk watch at a leased ridge lookout. Clerks post C=blake2s(addr||slip||staff_tag||lookout_id||slot). Fee is 0.46 POA; 21 POA bonds nine epochs. Auditors overlay lookout tape on the river gauge and match the staff assay to the flood-line map. A doubled slip, reused staff, or empty lookout seizes the bond and parks both keys for fourteen epochs.
